result.finding: Docker Compose is the only orchestration tool used, managing a 2-service local deployment (Java application + Oracle DB). No Kubernetes manifests, Docker Swarm configuration, or CI/CD workflows detected.
evidence: docker-compose.yml present at project root defining 2 services: oracle-db and photoalbum-java-app
docker-compose.yml uses Compose Specification format (no version: field, requires Compose v2+)
No Kubernetes YAML manifests found (no k8s/, manifests/, or helm/ directories)
No Docker Swarm deploy: sections in docker-compose.yml
No .github/workflows/ CI/CD files found referencing kubectl, helm, or docker stack
values: Local development/deployment only — no production orchestration configured
